import sys
from itertools import permutations

def is_fixed_permutation(p):
    n = len(p)
    p = [int(x) - 1 for x in p]  # convert to 0-based
    visited = [False] * n
    for i in range(n):
        if not visited[i]:
            cycle = []
            x = i
            while not visited[x]:
                visited[x] = True
                cycle.append(x)
                x = p[x]
            if len(cycle) > 1:
                # Get the elements in the cycle in original order
                cycle_elements = [p[x] + 1 for x in cycle]
                # Sort cycle elements in descending order of their mapped values
                cycle_sorted = sorted(cycle, key=lambda x: -p[x])
                # Reconstruct the cycle in standard form
                standard_cycle = [p[x] + 1 for x in cycle_sorted]
                # Check if the standard cycle matches the original cycle elements
                if sorted(standard_cycle) != sorted(cycle_elements):
                    return False
    return True
